g.text: Loop: step after step, until the model asks no tool or a limit stops it.
Step mode: KOLONİ runs each step (below).
Session: a CLI keeps the loop and asks for KOLONİ's tools.
Native: a CLI uses its own tools; Approvals answers its asks.

g.text: Also: Attachments (your files), Browser (the agent's own browser), Skills, Cards (card helpers). The turn ends when the
Orchestrator asks no more tools: its copies come in, or wait in Ready for you, and a queued message starts the next turn.
